purpose: Test the frozen V15 state-machine revision on the unchanged systematic parameter family before any separately sealed restrained-MD campaign.

algorithm.mathematical_description: frozen-frame projected proximal root solver on article-reparameterized public paths
algorithm.common_initial_policy: One explicit initial_no_se_special_case: uncertainty is unavailable rather than zero, exactly one initial-scale proposal is allowed, and all later noise decisions require real blocks.
algorithm.relative_residual_stop_policy: After at least one movement, stop the frozen inner solve only when the one-sided confidence condition U(P_j) <= r L(P_0) is true. If it is false, including interval overlap or any other unresolved stop decision, continue with an admissible movement until a clear stop or m_max; do not purchase an exact-center resample merely to resolve r.
algorithm.unresolved_lbfgs_advantage_policy: Before global warm takeover, select L-BFGS only when its positive score advantage over H0 is statistically resolved. Otherwise H0 is the required fallback: move with H0 only when H0 is valid and its own improvement lower confidence bound is strictly positive; if that H0 lower bound is nonpositive with positive reducible uncertainty, HOLD is allowed. The nonselected L-BFGS candidate's own lower bound cannot bypass an unresolved takeover comparison.
algorithm.post_takeover_policy: The one-way warm takeover and its bounded warm scalar safeguard are unchanged; after takeover H0 remains forbidden. An invalid warm candidate with positive reducible uncertainty selects exact-center HOLD, while an invalid warm candidate without reducible uncertainty terminates without another query.

revision_rationale.role_in_v15: Revision rationale only. No V14 path, metric, diagnostic rank, or outcome is used to change the V15 grid, horizon, acceptance rules, passing order, or selection baseline.
revision_rationale.observed_failure_mode: Under calibrated synthetic noise, the symmetric residual ambiguity rule and unresolved direction-comparison rule could repeatedly select exact-center HOLD, so V15 removes those two avoidable ambiguity traps without changing the scientific performance screen.

parameter_grid.story: The complete V14 factorial is repeated unchanged so the effect of the V15 state-machine revision is not confounded with post-result parameter refinement. Alpha retains integer mantissas; the two r and m_max levels remain separated enough to expose genuine outer/inner trajectory changes.

deterministic.single_block_standard_error_policy: exactly zero in this development oracle only

posthoc_scoring.scoring_oracle: the deterministic FES spline plus frozen historical-M interpolant
posthoc_scoring.candidate_paths_scored: every public path at its exact 20-query-equivalent checkpoint
posthoc_scoring.baseline: actual archived current-IVM paths through 2000 incremental NoF, rescored by the same deterministic scoring oracle
posthoc_scoring.barrier_quantity: absolute error relative to the frozen FES minimax barrier

required_for_full_screen_pass.I_perp_G: three-synthetic-seed median strictly lower than current IVM at every checkpoint
required_for_full_screen_pass.I_arc: three-synthetic-seed median no higher than current IVM at every checkpoint
required_for_full_screen_pass.Delta_F_error: three-synthetic-seed median strictly lower than current IVM at every checkpoint

posthoc_scoring.deterministic_guard: The deterministic trajectory must satisfy the same front/middle pointwise rules and all three lower tail AUCs; it cannot be rescued by noisy repetitions.

selection_rule.eligible: valid exact-prefix runs that pass the correct-path guard
selection_rule.primary: full deterministic guard and full three-seed synthetic front/middle plus noisy-tail screen pass
passing_order: larger count of joint front/middle checkpoint wins
larger minimum component tail checkpoint win fraction
smaller worst individual synthetic-seed normalized tail I_perp_G AUC ratio
smaller worst individual synthetic-seed normalized tail Delta_F_error AUC ratio
smaller deterministic worst all-metric checkpoint ratio
selection_rule.if_no_combination_passes: Do not promote a merely best-looking failure to formal MD; diagnose or revise the algorithm, then freeze a complete new development screen.
selection_rule.if_fewer_than_three_pass: A formal pilot may include the passing combinations only after registration; any further parameter refinement must first be a complete predeclared factorial bracket rather than isolated additions.

required_before_execution: V15 source passes frozen-frame, post-reparameterization-step, secant, noise, resampling, takeover, one-sided confident r stop, unresolved-LBFGS H0 fallback, m_max, NoF, resume, and budget-prefix tests.
Algorithm source and this plan are hashed into the development result manifest.
Formal paper PDFs remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
